matches.rationale: Finding 1 identifies the same core inconsistency described in GT1: modalities (POI/road) that are supposedly tied to masking are not actually recovered by the loss/prediction formulation, matching the mechanism of masking vs. recovery mismatch even though it frames it via the loss equations rather than the masking definition.

None of the findings address the SC-MoE gating/noise formulation described in GT2; findings 2 and 3 concern masking protocol discrepancies and loss-function wording, unrelated to the gating mechanism.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Correctly identifies the mismatch between claimed full recovery of masked modalities and the loss functions that only cover spatial/temporal modalities, matching GT1.
Points to a plausible discrepancy in masking protocol description between sections, but this is not part of the listed ground-truth defects.
Flags a legitimate mismatch between the stated MSE loss and the L2 norm formula, but this is unrelated to either ground-truth defect.
